title: State-Dependent Affine Bellman Barriers, Asymptotic Equivalence, and the Institutional U-Curve: Analytical Extensions on Minimum Viable Scale
description: Analytical extensions, sharpened First Passage Bellman Barrier (FPBB) certificates, outward-rounded interval-arithmetic and 8-subinterval continuum branch-and-bound proofs, restricted-M DP/VFI slack decomposition, asymptotic fixed- vs. endogenous-labor equivalence with continuous-state VFI (extended to weak patience beta*theta > 1 via Corollary 2*), Barro-CES institutional U-curves, firm decentralization, balanced growth, Stochastic Bellman Barriers (Lemma 2 Doob supermartingale certificate, Proposition 4* continuous log-PWL Doob deadlines T*(p) and 32-subbox x [beta_-, beta_+] coupled 2x2 Markov barrier systems with uniform escape eps_0 > 0, plus 880-point golden-section stochastic VFI experiments), and Technical Appendix A.1-A.4 building on Milei and Reidel (2026), 'Minimum Viable Scale: Bellman Barriers and the Economics of Survival'. Includes synchronized English and Spanish manuscripts (PDF/Typst/LaTeX), figure-generation scripts, and reproducible verification code.
notes: Includes bilingual preprints: mvs_improvements_en.pdf (English, 37 pp.) and mvs_mejoras_paper.pdf (Spanish, 40 pp.). Analytical development, technical editing, and Python verification routines were assisted by AI tools under the author's direction, critical review, and sole responsibility.
